assets.prompt: Edit the repair-kit sprite: replace EVERY white or gray checkerboard pixel in the background with one completely flat uniform hot magenta color RGB(255,0,255), hex #FF00FF. NO checkerboard. No texture, no gradients, no shadows on the backdrop. Do not change the brown leather repair tool pouch, hammer, whetstone or their stepped pixel-art silhouette at all. This will be imported as a color-keyed game sprite. The background needs to be perfectly uniform magenta right up to the hard object edges. Keep the subject centered with clear margin.
assets.creationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE game inventory sprite: a medieval equipment repair kit, a small rolled brown leather tool pouch containing a short steel hammer and a whetstone. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, a sheet of original Darksaber 32x32 game items shown enlarged: match its very low pixel count, earthy brown leather, muted steel with pale tiny highlights, one-pixel dark contour and sharply stepped pixel edges. Draw the repair kit as a single readable compact object, slight three-quarter view. STRICT target is a 32 by 32 pixel sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor to a square PNG, not detailed illustration: object occupies about 26 by 26 logical pixels, centered with 3 logical pixels clear padding. Genuine transparent RGBA background, including holes between tools. No background rectangle, checkerboard, shadow plane, text, letters, badge, border, UI frame, labels, glow, or extra item variants. Use about 12-18 flat pixel colors; no antialiasing or soft gradients. Only the one repair-kit sprite.
